proposed.explanation: The profit belonging to Talaat Moustafa's own shareholders (Shareholders of the Parent Company, consolidated) grew from 9,025,066,065 LE in the restated 2024 period to 14,383,890,306 LE in 2025, an increase of approximately 59.4% ( (14,383,890,306 - 9,025,066,065) / 9,025,066,065 ). This strong year‑over‑year growth, combined with the 2025 earnings per share of 6.98 LE (evidence_id TMGH‑TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en‑p7‑61), implies a price‑to‑earnings ratio of roughly 82.50 / 6.98 ≈ 11.8, which is modest for a company delivering nearly 60% profit growth. The investor has a long‑term horizon (5‑10 years), high willingness to accept losses, and medium financial ability to withstand them, making the addition of exposure to a fast‑growing Egyptian listed firm appropriate. With 30,000 EGP in cash and a share price of 82.50 EGP, the investor can purchase 363 shares for about 29,947.50 EGP, leaving a small cash buffer. claims.statement: Shareholders of the Parent Company (consolidated) profit attributable to owners in 2025 was 14,383,890,306 LE.
Shareholders of the Parent Company (consolidated) profit attributable to owners in the restated 2024 period was 9,025,066,065 LE.
Earnings per Share for 2025 was 6.98 LE.

limitations: Growth calculation uses only the consolidated shareholders‑of‑parent figure; other profit metrics (e.g., net profit, gross profit) are not employed.
The 2024 figure is restated; any prior‑year adjustments are not examined.
Valuation (P/E) is based solely on the given share price and EPS; market conditions, macro‑economic factors, and other financial ratios are not considered.
The recommendation assumes the investor’s cash of 30,000 EGP remains available and that transaction costs are negligible.
